title: Box says Hey Jude, but the song is Let It Be...
text: Box says Hey Jude, but the song is Let It Be.... [[VIDEOID:99ef18122d768b95e4e3734b60f071b3]] Nice looking box, but the song is LET IT BE, not HEY JUDE. I actually wouldn't mind it at all if they hadn't installed the "Hey Jude" nameplate. But since you installed a nameplate, you need to get the song right. LOL!  In terms of whether or not this is giftable, it is not. This is for personal use, so it's no big deal. I'll fix the nameplate when I have time. I'll subtract 2 stars for the wrong name plate.
